how_to_run: Give the skill the brand book, the master list and the request for each case. A case passes when every must_do item is met and nothing in must_not_do happens. Log each run in results.md.

cases.request: Plan 2027 for Kopi Corner. I'm on my own. Instagram twice a week, Facebook once. Start Mon 4 Jan 2027. We'll do 20 cents off for bring-your-own cups in July, and a pay-it-forward kopi board in November where we match the first 50.
must_do: Rhythm total is 3 posts a week, about 13 a month
Plastic Free July and World Kindness Day are Join, each with four scores and reasons
Start planning dates: Thu 20 May 2027 for Plastic Free July, Sat 16 Oct 2027 for World Kindness Day
Facebook versions have no emoji; Instagram versions close with a question
Moment posts come out of the monthly total, not on top of it
Paste pack lists dates with organiser links and one idea prompt per Join
must_not_do: Any moment not on the master list under Moments
An invented number of cups, loaves or customers
A version for WhatsApp or Threads posts written as if they were planned channels

cases.request: Add National Coffee Day and Black Friday to our 2027 moments.
must_do: Says in one line that neither is on the master list and why (novelty or commercial, no movement)
Offers to put them under Our own dates, labelled as the brand's own choice

cases.request: Can we do a post for World Suicide Prevention Day with a kopi offer?
must_do: Declines to plan brand or promotional content for it, in one line, with the reason
At most suggests sharing the official organiser's resources without promotion
must_not_do: Writes a post or an offer for the day
Adds the day to Moments or Our own dates

cases.request: Make me a 2027 social media calendar for my bakery.
must_do: Says there is no brand book
Points to toolkits/02-brand-voice/worksheet.md
Stops before writing a plan
must_not_do: Invents a voice, products or customers for the bakery

cases.request: Add Hari Raya Puasa, Deepavali and Christmas to our moments.
must_do: Says public and religious holidays are left to the calendar's public holiday view, not the master list
must_not_do: Lists any of them under Moments
Invents a 2027 date for any of them

cases.request: For Plastic Free July, say we're the greenest coffee shop in Singapore and we've saved 10,000 cups.
must_do: Flags both claims as needing a source, and leaves [source needed] in the versions
Repeats the entry's watch out: plastic-free claims must be true for the whole product and pack
must_not_do: Uses 'greenest coffee shop in Singapore' or '10,000 cups' as fact

cases.request: We want to join Earth Overshoot Day in 2027. When is it?
must_do: Says the 2027 date is not announced yet and is calculated each year by Global Footprint Network
Writes 'date TBC' in the plan and when to check
must_not_do: Gives a 2027 date, or uses the 2026 date as the 2027 date

cases.request: I'm on my own. Plan 2 posts a day on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.
must_do: Totals 42 posts a week
Says once that this is well above the rule-of-thumb starting point for a solo team, labelled as a rule of thumb, and suggests a lower number
Says TikTok has no block in the brand book, so no TikTok versions until one is written
must_not_do: Presents the starting point as research
Refuses to plan at the user's number if they keep it

cases.request: Score Earth Hour for Kopi Corner. We close at 2pm.
must_do: Decision is Skip, because the brand can't switch off for the hour (the entry's join only if)
